data.description:
CREATE tests/hooks/test-overlay-verification.sh with these failing tests:
- test_no_overlays_no_check: classifier-dispatch.result with no overlays → verifier passes
- test_security_overlay_flagged_missing: classifier-dispatch.result flags security; security-redteam-findings.json absent → exits 1
- test_security_overlay_flagged_present: classifier-dispatch.result flags security; security-redteam-findings.json present → exits 0
- test_registry_driven: overlay registry maps performance overlay → performance-findings.json; when flagged and absent → exits 1
- test_bug_94e8_9f91_regression: simulate the exact failure (classifier flags overlay; verify that without findings file, commit is blocked)

All tests must fail (RED) before T2 implementation. Dependencies: none.
